create_ImageFeaturesH5Reader: create an ImageFeaturesH5Reader instance to load pre-extracted image features from an LMDB database
read_image_features: read image features, bounding boxes, and normalized locations for a given image id from the reader
get_image_count: get the total number of images stored in the LMDB features database
list_image_keys: list all image id keys available in the ImageFeaturesH5Reader
load_features_in_memory: load image features into memory for faster repeated access during training
